records.review_note: HucM is 189 aa; the deposited chain is only residues20-79. The 60-aa structure is fragment evidence, never a replacement for the full reference or proof of a complete domain. Primary co-purification/mass-spectrometry and deletion evidence supports the named HucM role; deletion does not abolish catalytic H2 activity.
records.kind_policy: Keep module, preserve full189-aa sequence and genomic coordinates; assembly role is distinct from catalytic identity.

records.review_note: Near-complete NiFe catalytic-scaffold homology; the native Nostoc hupL role is independently supported by insertional mutagenesis (2002). This is not an identical Huc allele: atmospheric affinity, O2 properties and partner specificity are not transferred. PF00374 remains partial at0.6909 collinear model coverage.
records.kind_policy: Keep native Hup reference system, not Huc subtype.
